identity.evidence: The published logo file is the header logo image of generationai.au (img alt 'logo smaller', in the site's own WordPress uploads at wp-content/uploads/2024/07/logo-smaller.svg). generationai.au drops connections from this environment (curl and urllib, via the resolver and direct), so the bytes were retrieved from the Internet Archive's capture of the exact asset URL (2024-09-05) and SHA-256-verified against that capture; the archive's 2025-07-22 capture of the homepage header still references the same uploads URL. The mark is the Generation AI wordmark, a wide mark; the Atlas wide-mark class preserves its proportions.
